rows.text: The Jets are 3-12-1 ATS off a game decided by 3 or fewer points over the last five seasons (-$935), failing to cover by 7.1 PPG. That is the worst mark of any team in the NFL in that span.
Geno Smith is 16-6 to the first-half Under as a starter since the start of last season (+$940). That is the best mark of 34 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.
Kirk Cousins is 0-6 ATS with John Hussey officiating over the last decade (-$600), failing to cover by 8.9 PPG.

The homestand hasn't been a friendly space for Aaron Glenn. This will be his 3rd game as a head coach where the Jets will stay at home and play consecutive home games -- Jets are 0-2 SU/ATS in those previous matchups, being outscored 64-20 combined, losing by 20+ pts in both games.

Raiders got smoked 45-17 in New England earlier this year and road trips out east (in EST) haven't been great for the Raiders. They are 10-24 SU and 10-23-1 ATS over the last decade out east. In the Raiders last 16 games out east, they are 2-14 SU and 4-12 ATS dating back to their playoff game vs. Bengals in 2021-22.
Now or never. Raiders are the 2nd team since 1990 to enter the season with a win total under 7, start 3-0 SU then lose 4 straight, joining the 2002 Panthers.
Aaron Glenn is mainly 5-19 SU as the Jets head coach because they can’t stop teams in the first half. Jets are 4-17-3 1H SU under Glenn, with opp. averaging 15.5 PPG.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: Dak Prescott is 1-10 ATS against the NFC West since 2020 (-$913), failing to cover by 7.2 PPG. That is the worst mark of 15 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.
Games officiated by Ron Torbert are 64-44-1 to the Under since 2020 (+$1,418).

Cardinals and Seahawks finish off a guantlet schedule run this week, facing their 4th straight opp. with a preseason win total of above 9. Teams in that spot are 23-46 SU and 26-43 ATS last 15 seasons.
Dak Prescott has started 40 career games where the total was above 50 — he is just 15-25 ATS in those games, including 9-18 ATS as a favorite.
In Dak Prescott’s career, he is 27-10 SU and 22-15 ATS playing at home off a SU win — but he is just 2-4 SU/ATS in his last six games in this spot with no wins by more than 3 pts.

The Cowboys haven’t done a good job at covering big numbers.

As a favorite of 6+ pts, they’ve lost 5 in a row ATS, with their last cover coming at the end of the 2023 season.

As a fav. of 6+ pts at home, Dak & Dallas have lost 3 straight games outright vs Bucs, Saints and Packers.
Cowboys have been strong in the second halves. They are 5-1-1 SU, 5-2 ATS in 3Q and 5-1-1 SU and 6-1 ATS in 4Q this season.
Jacoby Brissett has started eight road games with a road game on deck in his career -- the start of a road trip. His teams are 1-7 SU in those games, losing by 8.8 PPG.
Jacoby Brissett has lost 25 consecutive starts when the opposing team scores 21+ points, with his last win coming in Week 1 of 2022 with the Browns.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: The Buccaneers are 1-11 ATS at home since the start of last season (-$1,009), failing to cover by 4.3 PPG. That is the worst mark of any team in the NFL in that span.

Falcons are 5-0 to the first-half Over against NFC opponents this season, including 6-1 to the 1H over in each of their 7 games.

Michael Penix Jr. is 5-0 to the first-half Over as a starter this season.
Kevin Stefanski is 12-25 against the first-half spread on the road over the last five seasons (-$1,550). That is the worst mark of 44 head coaches with at least 10 such games in that span.

As head coach of the Bucs, Todd Bowles is 6-11 SU and 5-12 ATS off a game where Tampa wins by 10+ pts.

In the 1H of those games, they are 3-13-1 SU and 5-12 ATS as well.

When the opponent scores 21+ pts on a Baker Mayfield-led Bucs team, Tampa is 5-26 SU (16%), they’ve lost ten in a row.

That 16% win pct (min 15 gms) is 5th-lowest among 32 QBs since start of 2023. Only QBs lower on the list are Geno Smith, Gardner Minshew, Cam Ward and Jacoby Brissett.
As a home favorite, Baker Mayfield is 13-27-1 ATS (32.5%) in his career as a starter. No other QB has made 40+ starts as a home favorite and had an ATS win pct of 33% or less in the Super Bowl era.
A different situation. Kevin Stefanski is 4-12 SU and 5-11 ATS as a road dog in divisional games. With the Falcons, he is 1-0 SU/ATS, another opportunity this week.
The 30-40 rule comes into effect for the Bucs this week. Teams after winning by 30+ and scoring 40+ are 21-32-1 ATS when listed as a favorite in their next game over the last decade.
The favorite in an NFC South divisional game is 16-34-1 ATS over the last 5 seasons, including 5-10 SU and 3-12 ATS since start of last season.
Falcons first quarters this season have been fireworks, they are 7-0 to the over, only team undefeated to the over or under in the opening frame.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: Favorites with Alex Kemp officiating are 30-10 ATS over the last three seasons (+$1,751), covering by 6.6 PPG.

Browns have not had a lot of success in PIttsburgh ... at all. Steelers are 22-1 SU and 16-7 ATS at home vs Browns since 2004, with their only loss actually coming in the playoffs back in 2020-21.

Just in the regular season, Steelers have won 22 straight home games vs Browns -- with their last loss coming back in October of 2003.

The road trip hasn't been a great thing for the Browns in recent history. Since 2018, the are 3-18 SU and 5-16 ATS when playing their 2nd or more consecutive road games. The hope? They are 1-0 SU/ATS already this season in this spot, beating the Bucs.

The Cleveland Browns entered the season with a win total of 5.5 and they've started 5-2 SU and can go over their win total for the season this week.

+ With their next win, Cleveland will go over their win total in consecutive seasons for the first time since 2001-02.
+ No team has gone over or under their win total for the season in their 8th game or earlier since 2013 (KC, HOU).

Deshaun Watson and the Browns are 3-1 ATS in their next game after a SU win this season -- a big change from the past. Watson hasn't finished a season above .500 ATS off a win since 2017 -- Watson is 18-21-1 ATS in this spot for his career.
The Browns are 2-2 ATS on the road so far this season. Dating back to 2015, Cleveland has finished above .500 ATS on the road just once, in 2018.
Aaron Rodgers has started 20 total games vs a first-year head coach since the start of 2018, he is just 7-13 ATS in those games, losing 4 in a row ATS, including his first game vs Browns this season.

QB revenge is something Aaron Rodgers has been good at no matter where he is in his career. Steelers lost to the Browns earlier this year, Rodgers vs Watson, now he faces him again.

Rodgers is 39-25-1 ATS (61%) in a QB revenge game (across seasons) as a starter, including 5-2 ATS with Steelers.

Browns just covered and won on the road against the Titans and now play on the road again...

+ Browns haven't even covered two straight road games (not even in consecutive games) since Week 10 of 2023.
+ Weeks 13 and 15 of 2020 is the last time the Browns won and covered two straight road games (not consecutive games).
+ Last time Browns won and covered two straight games, both of which on the road, was back in Weeks 11 and 12 of 2002.

When previous game is an International Series game and team is on 7 days rest or less, where current game is not International, so home or road -- those teams are 18-15-1 SU and 14-20 ATS -- but since the start of last year, they are 3-6-1 SU and 1-9 ATS.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: Home favorites with Adrian Hill officiating are 0-12 ATS since the start of last season (-$1,200), failing to cover by 7.9 PPG. Fits this week: Jaguars.

The Jags have dominated the Colts in recent history. They are 14-8 SU, but an astounding 18-3-1 ATS against Indy since 2015 (+$1,415), covering by 9 PPG.

At home in Jacksonville, they have beaten the Colts in 10 straight meetings, going 9-1 ATS. Andrew Luck is the last Colts QB to win in Jacksonville.
The Jaguars are 19-7 to the first-half Under at home over the last four seasons (+$1,130). That is the best mark of any team in the NFL in that span.
Trevor Lawrence is 0-6 ATS with Adrian Hill officiating in his career (since 2021) (-$600), failing to cover by 14.2 PPG.
The Jaguars are 14-5 ATS in division games over the last four seasons (+$781), covering by 3.4 PPG. That is the best mark of any team in the NFL in that span.

Liam Coen and Trevor Lawrence are 9-2 SU/ATS at home in Jacksonville and just 6-7 ATS playing away from Jacksonville.

Here is the impact on scoring for the team as well:
• 30.8 PPG at home
• 24.1 PPG on road/neutral

Colts have lost 9 consecutive games outright vs teams above .500 SU dating back to last season. Since the start of 2024, they are 3-15 SU and 8-10 ATS vs. teams above .500.

In Daniel Jones' career as a starter, he is 10-28-1 SU (18-21 ATS) vs. teams above .500.
With the Colts, Daniel Jones has closed as an underdog of 3+ points six times — Indy is 0-6 SU and 3-3 ATS, but 3-0 ATS when they close +4 or higher.
Daniel Jones usually isn’t his best outdoors. But as an underdog outdoors he’s 2-15 SU and 5-12 ATS in his last 17 games in that spot dating back to 2023.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: The Ravens are 13-2 to the Over off a loss over the last three seasons (+$982), going over the total by 3.5 PPG. That is the best mark of any team in the NFL in that span.
Lamar Jackson is 14-3 ATS on turf over the last five seasons (+$960), covering by 6.0 PPG. That is the best mark of 45 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.
Lamar Jackson is 3-12 ATS outdoors since the start of last season (-$944), failing to cover by 4.0 PPG. That is the 2nd-worst mark of 21 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.
Home teams with a win total of 10 or more are 7-20-2 ATS this season (-$1,344), failing to cover by 3.4 PPG. Fits this week: Bills, Bengals, Lions, Rams, Seahawks.
The Ravens are 5-0 to the full game over and first half over as a road underdog over the last four seasons (+$455), going over the full game total by 9.6 PPG.
Josh Allen is 37-21 to the first-half Over against AFC opponents over the last five seasons (+$1,390).
Josh Allen is 5-14 against the first-half spread as a favorite since the start of last season (-$1,040). That is the worst mark of 20 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.
The Ravens are 0-4 straight up with Clay Martin officiating over the last five seasons (-$400).
Ravens have had an issue coming out of the locker room. This season, they are 1-6 against the spread in the 3rd quarter, worst mark in the NFL. Over the last three seasons, Ravens are 16-26-1 3Q ATS.

Lamar Jackson is 82-37 SU, 61-57-1 ATS in his NFL career as a whole. His super power has been the 69-48-2 1H ATS mark as well.

All other QBs to start for the Ravens in this span have gone 11-19 SU and 16-14 ATS.
Lamar Jackson has started four games this season. Ravens are 4-0 SU/ATS in the first half of those games.
It’s been a dangerous thing to give the Ravens the hook. Since start of 2018, they are 11-3 ATS getting 3.5 pts or more.
In 2019, Lamar got the best of Josh in Buffalo. Since then, Bills have won and covered three straight at home vs. Lamar Jackson and Ravens.

The 4th quarter in Bills games this season have seen chaos and that has led to them being 6-0 to the over -- the only team in the NFL undefeated to the over or under in the 4th quarter.

Bills have leaned to the over in the 4th quarter in each of the last four seasons dating back to 2023.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: Kyler Murray is 4-22 against the first-half spread in division games since 2020 (-$2,020). That is the worst mark of 47 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.
Jared Goff has faced off against Kyler Murray five times as starting QBs -- Goff is 5-0 SU (4-0-1 ATS), winning those five matchups by 13.8 PPG.
Miami On Deck: Lions travel to Miami to face the Dolphins next week. Teams with a road game to Miami on deck are just 15-28 ATS last 5 seasons, including 4-16 ATS in the last 20 games in this spot.

Four times in the Super Bowl era has an undefeated team in their 7th game or later been an underdog of 3+ pts vs a team with a win pct below 70%. All 4 lost outright (1-3 ATS).

• 2009 Broncos (+4.5) vs BAL
• 2009 Vikings (+6) at PIT
• 2000 Vikings (+3) at TB
• 1974 Cardinals (+5.5) at DAL

An undefeated team entering their 7th game who is averaging under 21 PPG -- hasn't been done since the 1978 Rams.

Undefeated teams who average 24 PPG or less at this point in the season have gone just 8-12 ATS.
When the Vikings don’t lose the turnover margin under Kevin O’Connell they are 41-5 SU (89%), the best mark of any team in the NFL.

Vikings join the list of unexpected undefeated teams on a winning streak.

Here is the list of teams to win 11 straight outright across seasons (or single season) and had a win total under 10 in both seasons:
2026 Vikings, 2020 Steelers, 2015 Panthers, 2009 Saints, 2002 Patriots, 1991 Redskins

The Lions are coming off a win vs Packers but they failed to cover the 3.5 pt spread. Under Dan Campbell and Jared Goff, Lions have actually lost 8 consecutive games ATS after a SU win, with their last cover in Week 5 of last season, over a year ago.

Jared Goff has 14 pass TD and 0 interceptions through six games with the Lions. Only one other QB in NFL history has 14+ pass TD, 0 INT through six games and that was Russell Wilson in 2019 with the Seahawks.

This will be just the 2nd time a team on an 11-plus game SU win streak is listed as an underdog in a divisional game in the Super Bowl era. The other time was the Ravens against the Steelers in 2019, a Baltimore win with their backup QB, Robert Griffin III in for Lamar Jackson.

So this will be the first time ever with a starting QB.
The 4th quarter has been a special place for the Vikings this season -- they are 6-0 SU and ATS in the final frame -- only team undefeated in either category.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text:
League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.
The Titans are 1-11 ATS with the Jaguars on deck since 2020 (-$1,005), failing to cover by 8.9 PPG.

Cam Ward is 0-5 against the first-half spread against AFC opponents this season. In his career, Ward is 4-20 SU and 6-17-1 ATS in the first half of his 24 starts.

Robert Saleh and Ward as a QB-coach duo are 0-7 straight up and 0-6-1 against the first-half spread together.
Home favorites with Brad Allen officiating are 8-17 ATS over the last three seasons (-$965). Fits this week: Bengals.
Since the start of 2021, Joe Burrow is just 13-6 SU (68.4%) as a favorite of 6+ points -- of 14 QBs with 15+ starts in that spot, he has the lowest SU win pct.

Tennessee has now lost 13 consecutive games both SU and ATS after an outright win dating back to Week 12 of 2022. That is the longest ATS losing streak for any team in the Super Bowl era.

After a SU loss, Titans are 8-4 ATS in their last 12 games in that spot.

Joe Burrow has closed above a one possession favorite (-8.5 or more) just four times as a starter, he is 2-2 SU and 1-3 ATS in those games.

He’s closed above a TD favorite (-7.5 or more) ten times as a starter — he is 6-4 SU and 3-7 ATS.
Joe Burrow has done a good job at dominating bad teams in his career. he is 11-6-1 SU/ATS vs. teams with a win pct of 25% or less, scoring 27 PPG in those matchups.
The 2nd quarter has been an absolute disaster for the Titans this season -- they are 0-7 SU and ATS in the frame.
Bengals haven't closed as a favorite of 12 pts or more since 2015 -- a game started by Andy Dalton for Cincinnati against Johnny Manziel and the Browns.

rows.text: Mike Vrabel is 24-8 against the first-half spread in division games since 2020 (+$1,520). That is the best mark of 45 head coaches with at least 10 such games in that span.
Mike Vrabel is 12-3 to the Over against the AFC East since 2020 (+$791), going over the total by 5.6 PPG. That is the 2nd-best mark of 14 head coaches with at least 10 such games in that span.
Drake Maye is 9-3 ATS in division games in his career (since 2024) (+$516), covering by 6.6 PPG. That is the 2nd-best mark of 24 QBs with at least 10 such games since 2024.

Games officiated by Shawn Hochuli are 60-44-2 to the Under since 2020 (+$1,055). 

Favorites with Shawn Hochuli officiating are 43-60-2 ATS since 2020 (-$2,017).
On 10+ days prep time, Mike Vrabel's teams have been tough to beat -- they are 12-5 SU and 11-6 ATS, including 11-4-2 SU and 12-5 ATS in the first halves of those games.
Mike Vrabel has won and covered 6 games in a row off of a straight up loss and he is 27-18-3 ATS in that spot as a head coach, including 5-0 SU/ATS with the Patriots, covering the spread by 12.4 PPG.

With the Patriots and Titans, Mike Vrabel has coached 25 games where his team is coming off allowing 30+ points -- he is 20-5 SU and 17-7-1 ATS (70.8%) in those games.

Vrabel's 70.8% ATS win pct is tied for 2nd-best among all head coaches (min 20 gms) in Super Bowl era.

As a 3+ point favorite, Drake Maye is 16-0 SU (12-4 ATS) as a starting QB, best SU mark (min 10 gms) in Super Bowl era.

For more perspective, Maye is 16-0 SU in this spot in his first 40 career starts --the only other QB 10-0 SU or better in their first 40 career starts in this spot was Jim McMahon at 12-0 SU.
Last decade, teams coming off their first win of the season this late into the year (7th game or later), are just 3-10 SU and 5-7-1 ATS in their next game.

Patriots have won and covered 6 games in a row off of a straight up loss entering this week after losing to the Bears on Thursday Night Football.

Mike Vrabel is 27-18-3 ATS off a SU loss as a head coach, including 5-0 SU/ATS with the Patriots, covering the spread by 12.4 PPG.
Patriots are 4-10 SU and 3-10-1 ATS on the road in Miami since 2012.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: The Chiefs are 10-0 to the Under off a loss since the start of last season (+$909), going under the total by 7.8 PPG. That is the best mark of any team in the NFL in that span.

The Chiefs are 17-4 to the Under against the AFC West over the last four seasons (+$1,145), going under the total by 6.3 PPG.

Sean Payton is 7-0 to the Under against Andy Reid over the last four seasons (+$636), going under the total by 8.2 PPG.
The Broncos are 4-0 to the Under with Clete Blakeman officiating over the last five seasons (+$364), going under the total by 14.6 PPG.
The Chiefs are 16-3 to the Under with a total of 44 or lower over the last three seasons (+$1,155), going under the total by 6.3 PPG. That is the best mark of any team in the NFL in that span.

In division, Patrick Mahomes has been the grim reaper on the road. He is 19-2 SU, going 13-0 SU vs Raiders and Chargers .. and 6-2 SU against Denver, with his only two losses at Mile High.

In those 19 road divisional games, Mahomes and the Chiefs have been either underdogs or favored by 3.5 pts or less six times and they are 6-0 SU/ATS.
Since the beginning of last season, the 1st half under is 18-8 in Broncos games, going under the total by 2.4 PPG.
Blackjack: When the opponent scores 21 pts or more vs a team with a Bo Nix-led offense on the other side, Denver is 7-11 SU and 6-12 ATS. At 20 pts or less, Nix is 23-2 SU and 19-6 ATS.
A good Denver team, at home, as an underdog has historically been a good bet. The Broncos are 22-15 SU and 25-12 ATS when they are above .500 SU and a home underdog in the Super Bowl era.

A November lull? Patrick Mahomes ATS by month since start of 2024…

January: 1-1 ATS
February: 0-1 ATS
September: 6-4-1 ATS
October: 6-4 ATS
November: 0-9 ATS
December: 3-3 ATS

In Mahomes’ last ten road starts in the AFC West, the Chiefs are 2-7-1 ATS.

Mahomes started his career 4-0 SU/ATS in Denver. Since 2021, he’s 2-2 SU and 0-4 ATS, losing two in a row outright, scoring fewer than 20 pts in both games.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text:
Dan Quinn is 8-1 to the Over against the NFC East since the start of last season (+$627).

Nick Sirianni is 7-1 to the Over against the Commanders over the last four seasons (+$536), going over the total by 13.1 PPG.
Nick Sirianni is 7-1 to the Over against the Commanders over the last four seasons (+$536), going over the total by 13.1 PPG.
The Commanders are 2-9 ATS against a backup QB over the last five seasons (-$706), failing to cover by 6.9 PPG. That is the 2nd-worst mark of any team in the NFL in that span.

Dan Quinn is 12-4-1 to the Over against NFC opponents since the start of last season (+$691), going over the total by 3.5 PPG. That is the best mark of 17 head coaches with at least 10 such games in that span.

Commanders got a week out of the spotlight on a bye -- and for Dan Quinn teams that means a fast start to their next game. His teams are 20-9 1H ATS on any extended prep time and 44-50-1 1H ATS on 7 days rest or less.
Since the start of last season, teams after facing the Cowboys see their next game go 17-5 to the first half under.

Eagles have lost 4 straight games outright and 7 straight games ATS vs. the NFC, including 1-9 ATS in their last ten games vs NFC.

The 7-game ATS losing streak vs NFC opponents is tied for their longest streak as a franchise since the merger in 1970.
As coach of the Eagles, Nick Sirianni has now had to start a backup QB eight times, they are 2-6 SU/ATS in those games.
In 102 games as head coach of the Eagles, Sirianni has closed above a 3-pt underdog eleven times -- Philly is 1-10 SU and 3-8 ATS in those games.

Only one team in the NFL is winless in the second halves of games -> Eagles. They are 0-6-1 SU and 0-7 ATS in 2nd half this season. Eagles are first team since 2022 Packers to start 0-7 2H ATS. Since 2005, only the 2007 Broncos and 2006 Panthers started 0-8 2H ATS.

Winless 2H SU and ATS through 7 games: only three teams since 2005 before this year.

2006 Panthers (0-7 / 0-7, ran both to eight games)
2009 Buccaneers (0-7 / 0-7)
2021 Texans (0-7 / 0-7)

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.

rows.text: Home teams with Shawn Smith officiating are 29-10-1 ATS over the last three seasons (+$1,643), covering by 4.4 PPG.
Caleb Williams is 8-2-1 to the Over on the road since the start of last season (+$527), going over the total by 12.3 PPG. That is the 2nd-best mark of 19 QBs with at least 10 such games in that span.

The Bears have been in eight primetime games under Ben Johnson so far -- Chicago is 5-3 SU and 7-1 ATS in those games. He is 18-4-1 ATS in primetime as HC of Bears and OC of Lions combined.

Ten Bears HC have had at least 5 primetime games under their belt with the franchise, Johnson is the only one currently above .500 both SU and ATS.

Ben Johnson has done it all so far in Chicago -- except this. He's coached nine games vs NFC North, Chicago is 3-6 SU/ATS, including 1-4 SU/ATS as a favorite and 2-7 1H SU/ATS.

In 17 games against non-NFC North opponents, Ben Johnson and the Bears are 14-3 SU and 14-2-1 ATS.

This is Caleb Williams' second go-around facing Mike Macdonald. Chicago lost, but covered against Seattle the first time, in a 6-3 barnburner.

When Caleb faces an opposing head coach for the first time, he is 15-7-2 ATS, when he faces that coach a second time or more, he is 9-7 ATS.
Ben Johnson has coached three MNF games with the Bears, Chicago is 3-0 1H SU and ATS in those games, starting fast.

Seahawks finish off a gauntlet schedule run this week, facing their 5th straight opp. with a preseason win total of above 9. Teams in that spot, who are not off a bye, are 6-13 SU and 5-14 ATS last 15 seasons.

With the Jets, Sam Darnold started two home games at night in primetime. New York went 0-2 SU/ATS, losing by more than one possession in each game.

Since Darnold left the Jets, he has started 8 home night games with the Vikings and Seahawks, he is 8-0 SU, winning by 11.8 PPG.
Seahawks play their 3rd consecutive game in primetime at night. We've only see 35 examples of that dating back to 2005, those teams are 16-19 ATS in the 3rd game of that stretch.

League wide trends entering Week 8
• 6+ pt favorites are 22-10 SU but 8-21-3 ATS this season -- 2nd-worst start ATS in Super Bowl era (2024).
• Teams with a rest advantage this season (in days) are 23-8 SU, 22-8-1 ATS (best start since 1994). These teams are 18-1 SU, 15-3-1 ATS as favorites, they were 7-0 SU in Week 7.
• Division dogs are 17-15-1 SU and 23-10 ATS. 2nd-best start ATS in the Super Bowl era (2010).
• Teams who entered the year with a double-digit win total (vs teams under that mark) are 14-28-3 ATS, worst start ATS since 1999.

Since the beginning of last season, only 3 QBs are 4+ games above .500 ATS as a favorite during the regular season ... and they are all in that spot this week:

Matthew Stafford: 14-7 ATS
Trevor Lawrence: 9-3 ATS
Drake Maye: 10-4 ATS

This season, ten different teams entered the year with under 20-1 odds to win it all -- LAR, BUF, BAL, SEA, KC, SF, LAC, DEN, DET, PHI -- when they've faced a team not among that group, they are 12-25-1 ATS. Three such matchups this week: MIN at DET, PHI at WAS, CHI and SEA.

Since start of last season, teams to lose by more than one possession, facing a team not in that spot, on normal rest or less (11 days), are 75-46-2 ATS (62%) in their next game. This week that is the Panthers, Cardinals, Ravens, Chiefs, Raiders and Eagles.

Steelers and Titans both have rest coming up after this week. Last decade, teams with 12+ days rest on deck, facing team not in that spot, are 56% SU and ATS. Since start of last year, they are 22-15-1 SU and 22-16 ATS.
The impact of high totals. Last decade, totals of 53+ are 33-28-1 (54%) to the over in the first 6 weeks of the season. In Week 7 on in regular season, the over is just 33-44-1 (43%).

The International Series game on deck hasn't been the best spot for teams. They are 49-64-3 ATS (43.4%) the game before going overseas. It has been a worse spot at home vs. road the week before, going 29-41-1 ATS.

Since 2020, here are the worst QBs on the moneyline as a 6+ point favorite (min 10 gms):

Russell Wilson: 10-5 SU (67%)
Trevor Lawrence: 8-4 SU (67%)
Joe Burrow: 13-6 SU (68%)
The Browns and Eagles are the only two teams in the NFL this season to not win a single first quarter outright.
Road teams having to cross 2+ time zones are 6-13 ATS through Week 7 this season, the worst start since 2006 and 2nd-worst start since 1980.
